project_info.theme: frozen gaze within a moving city crowd
project_info.color_palette: olive green, teal shadow, warm amber, gray concrete

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with windblown long dark hair, natural makeup, and an oversized olive-green utility jacket.

items: busy urban street and distant bokeh

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: cinematic teal-and-warm grade, natural contrast, and long-exposure peripheral blur

technical_specs.render_style: handheld 50mm street photograph, subject sharp at f/2.0, slow shutter crowd movement, subtle film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Candid street portrait of an adult woman standing centered and sharply focused in a busy city crowd. Anonymous passersby move around her in slow-shutter motion blur while windblown hair crosses her face. She wears an olive-green utility jacket and natural makeup, looking directly into the lens with an intense quiet gaze. Use handheld documentary framing, shallow depth of field, soft overcast daylight, cinematic teal-and-warm color grading, city-light bokeh, realistic film grain, and a frozen moment in chaos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, identifiable bystanders, paparazzi harassment, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All references are optional. Preserve adult subject, olive jacket, sharp-versus-blurred crowd contrast, and overcast documentary look. Do not render recognizable bystanders.
